why: Restores the exact defect issue #416 fixed: a code span that can only be seen when both backticks sit on one line. An opening backtick on one line and its closer on the next would again leave a `Parent: #N` mirror between them looking like prose, so an issue DOCUMENTING the form is audited as USING it -- a red required check whose remediation cannot be followed, because there is no parent to add. Nothing else observes it: the audit's other outputs are unchanged and the whole 181-issue corpus parses identically either way.
killedBy: native relationship contract blanks a code span that OPENS and CLOSES on different lines (issue #416)
